column4: dialect-gated: a single-gate test (not registeredBackends), guards on CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL being unset and skips ONCE before any subtest runs. This job supplies PostgreSQL only. Measured by NAME from this PR's own cluster job log (test-report.json), not guessed: exactly one skip event for this name, no subtest suffix, cleat#2125.

same test, same single top-level guard (see the cluster line and the source at engine/testutil/mssql_admin_predicate_restore_test.go) -- it skips once, unconditionally, whenever CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL is unset, independent of which postgres-only job invokes it. engine-race.yml runs ./engine/... (which includes engine/testutil) on PostgreSQL only, per skip-ledger.d/README.md's "usually needs two lines" note; this line was not measured from a live test-go/engine run (it is schedule-only and had not yet run against this branch) but derived from the guard's own unconditional shape, identically to the cluster count. cleat#2125, flagged by the coordinator after cleat#2155/#2157 caught the same gap on #2129/#2131/#2137.
